label: Ovid, Metamorphoses
summary: The great sourcebook of Greek and Roman myth, and a lifelong presence in Leonardo's imagination.

claims.statement: Entered as no. 31 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Literature, Poetry and Fables. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "Ovid's Metamorphoses".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Metamorphoses. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.

sources.cite: Museo Galileo, La Biblioteca di Leonardo, record for this title.

claims.statement: Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Completed 8 AD · Printed 1471.
check_in: ISTC (Incunabula Short Title Catalogue) or Edit16 record for the edition
